_comment: CLOSING template for the data-use demo, Spanish. The mirror of
templates/data_use_demo_close_en.json - read that file's comment for why this
exists; the reasoning is identical and is not repeated here.
In short: it goes only to people who never replied to the opener. They
never opened the 24-hour window, so a free-form message to them fails with
63016 and an approved template is the only way to give them closure.
Copy must match the `close_never_started` widget that
scripts/build_data_use_demo.py emits for Spanish. Framed for UTILITY.

twilio/text.body:
Hola {{1}}, gracias por tu tiempo. La breve encuesta por WhatsApp que te enviamos ya se cerró.

No necesitas responder nada y no volveremos a escribirte sobre este ejercicio.

Si quieres conocer lo que mostró el ejercicio, te esperamos en la sesión.

_Equipo IPA_
